text:
maria_cs: Kickoff — Nightingale reserved bakeoff tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final quota target, autoscale policy, loadtest owner, and exec summary for renewal. Can folks confirm?

sam_ops: I'm in. Proposal: start with quota 200k req/day (50 RU), reserve 4 GPUs min, burst to 8. Autoscale policy: cpu+gpu queue length target 5s, scale step 2 nodes.

lee_infra: FYI hardware is A100x2 per node in that pool. We have spare slots but not guaranteed after 14:00 PT.

ashley_se: I'll own load tests and ramp plan. Plan: 3 phases — smoke, stepped soak (3h), and stress. Need auth tokens and test dataset.

maria_cs: @ashley_se add short checklist for CS enablement. Also @quinn_re can you draft a 1-paragraph renewal note showing SLA and warmup plan?

quinn_re: Yep. Will draft by EOD. I'll call out canary windows and fallback to hosted model.

sam_ops: Loadtest command I'll use: ```./run_loadtest --target-nightingale --profile=stepped --concurrency=250 --duration=3h``` — we'll push via bastion.

deploy-bot: Scheduled loadtest job queued for 2025-10-12T09:00:00Z by ashley_se

lee_infra: Quick note: enable KV cache prefixing in runtime config to avoid cold-start L2 misses. Add `cache.prefetch=true` to the model config.

ashley_se: Adding that. Also need a contact list for oncall during the test. @sam_ops you ok to be first responder?

sam_ops: Yep, I'll be oncall 08:30–12:30 PT. I'll keep a runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-bakeoff

maria_cs: Risk: renewal touchpoint in 30 days. If the bakeoff shows >99.5% p95 latency and no cache regressions, we can include it in the renewal packet. Otherwise ops to follow up.

quinn_re: Noted. I'll include metrics window and acceptance criteria.

ashley_se: Quick QA: what metric tags do we need in the loadtest output? I want `model_variant`, `region`, `quota_bucket`.

lee_infra: Add `quota_bucket` as numeric id, model_variant string, and `seq_len_pctl` for tail behavior.

maria_cs: OK. Action items: ashley - runbook + test dataset (ETA EOD), sam - scale policy doc + oncall, lee - enable cache + node reservation, quinn - renewal blurb. We'll sync 08:00 PT tomorrow briefly. 

sam_ops: ack :thumbsup:

quinn_re: ack

deploy-bot: Loadtest job started 2025-10-12T09:00:00Z

ashley_se: Starting smoke now — posting a short log snippet:

ashley_se: ```
[09:01] smoke: 100 rps
[09:05] p95=120ms p99=450ms errors=0
```

maria_cs: Thanks — keep logs in thread. Ping if we see any throttle or quota errors.

sam_ops: If we hit quota errors, fallback plan: route 10% traffic to hosted endpoint and mark as degraded.

lee_infra: I'll watch GPU utilization. If we see sustained >85% for 10m, we'll scale.

ashley_se: Smoke looks good. Starting stepped soak now.

maria_cs: Great — I updated the renewal checklist with this timeline.

quinn_re: Putting draft renewal snippet in comments: "Reserved capacity proven with stepped soak showing p95 < 150ms; autoscale configured with graceful 2-node steps and KV prefetch reduces cold-starts." 

sam_ops: Noted, will add scale step numbers to the metrics dashboard.

ashley_se: Stepped soak steady. No errors so far.

deploy-bot: Loadtest job completed 2025-10-12T13:05:23Z — results uploaded to /artifacts/nightingale-bakeoff/4198765432

maria_cs: Final: preliminary pass. We'll run a short follow-up week after for churn tests. Thanks team.
